deliverables: Governance Incentives Framework and final report
Documented incentive models and formula outputs
At least one publication-ready research paper submitted for peer review
Completed and submitted Governance Incentives Framework CIP
Governance integration pathway and governance action submitted to DReps
request.what: Fund a 12-month project to create a Governance Incentives Framework for Cardano, including research, data infrastructure, incentive modeling, a controlled pilot, public reporting, and a governance integration pathway.

claims.claim: The proposal states that Cardano currently lacks a structured, data-driven framework for determining how governance contributions should be incentivized, measured, or supported over time.
The proposal states that active DReps declined in every 12-epoch period during Cardano's first year of on-chain governance, while voting-power concentration increased.
The Governance Incentives Working Group has created a mapping document identifying 49 relevant efforts, proposals, research papers, tools, and initiatives related to governance incentives.

The project will evaluate candidate incentive mechanisms using research, governance data, modeling, controlled testing, community input, and documented assumptions before presenting adoption decisions to governance.

The proposal says the framework will assess incentive models for participation, decentralization, concentration risk, accountability, gaming risk, shallow compliance behavior, and budget sustainability.
The project is planned as seven staged milestones over 12 months, with public reviewable outputs at each stage.
The proposal commits to public outputs including a website, dashboard, dataset, research reports, model documentation, pilot results, a submitted CIP, and a governance integration pathway.

The budget requests ₳4,207,967 across workstreams including modeling, research, community engagement, administration, data engineering, dashboarding, pilot work, contingency, and independent audit and oversight.
The document states that detailed operational budgeting is maintained separately for audit, administration, and delivery management rather than included in the proposal text.

The team claims relevant experience including Governance Incentives Working Group leadership, Cardano Ambassador work, prior Catalyst closeouts, blockchain consulting, and prior reward-design research contributions.

summary: The proposal requests ₳4,207,967 for a 12-month governance incentives R&D program intended to produce a public framework, dataset, dashboard, models, pilot findings, research publication, CIP, and integration pathway, with most delivery details stated in milestone form and detailed operational budgeting kept separate.
